svg.text: Five operational states · production-ready SVG reference

g.title: SecondOut — STREAMING
g.desc: SecondOut plugin interface in the STREAMING state.
g.text: SecondOut mirrors your audio to a second output.

g.title: SecondOut — BUFFERING
g.desc: SecondOut plugin interface in the BUFFERING state.

g.text: Usually ready in a few seconds
SecondOut mirrors your audio to a second output.

g.title: SecondOut — NO DEVICE
g.desc: SecondOut plugin interface in the NO DEVICE state.

g.text: Choose an output device to begin
SecondOut mirrors your audio to a second output.

g.title: SecondOut — DISCONNECTED
g.desc: SecondOut plugin interface in the DISCONNECTED state.

g.text: Reconnect the device, then select Retry
SecondOut mirrors your audio to a second output.

g.title: SecondOut — COULD NOT OPEN
g.desc: SecondOut plugin interface in the COULD NOT OPEN state.

g.text: Another app may be using this device
Close the other app or choose a different output
SecondOut mirrors your audio to a second output.
